years.source: [USD] https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/104169/000010416922000012/wmt-20220131.htm (Walmart Inc. FY2022 Form 10-K, year ended 31 Jan 2022) | Consolidated Statements of Income, Balance Sheets, Cash Flows, Walmart Inc. FY2022 Form 10-K (as-filed, fiscal year ended 31 Jan 2022). Total Debt = Short-term borrowings (410) + Long-term debt due within one year (2,803) + Long-term debt (34,864) = 38,077; EXCLUDES finance lease obligations (511 current + 4,243 non-current) for consistency with other companies' borrowing-only treatment. Interest Expense = gross interest on Debt (1,674) + Finance lease (320) = 1,994, before netting Interest income (158) -- consistent with data dictionary guidance to use gross interest expense where separately disclosed. Note: fiscal 2022 includes a one-off Loss on extinguishment of debt (2,410) and Other (gains) and losses (3,000, related to UK/Japan divestitures) below the operating income line -- does not affect EBIT/Operating income figure used here.

[USD] https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/104169/000010416923000020/wmt-20230131.htm (Walmart Inc. FY2023 Form 10-K, year ended 31 Jan 2023) | Consolidated Statements of Income, Balance Sheets, Cash Flows, Walmart Inc. FY2023 Form 10-K (as-filed). Total Debt = Short-term borrowings (372) + Long-term debt due within one year (4,191) + Long-term debt (34,649) = 39,212; excludes finance lease obligations, consistent with prior year. Interest Expense = gross interest on Debt (1,787) + Finance lease (341) = 2,128, before netting Interest income (254). RED FLAG: Operating income fell 21% YoY (25,942 -> 20,428) despite revenue growth (572,754 -> 611,289) -- margin compression. Note: prior year (FY2022) figures shown as comparative here match the actual FY2022 10-K figures already entered, confirming consistency.

FY2024 Form 10-K, year ended 31 Jan 2024) | Consolidated Statements of Income, Balance Sheets, Cash Flows, Walmart Inc. FY2024 Form 10-K (as-filed). Total Debt = Short-term borrowings (878) + Long-term debt due within one year (3,447) + Long-term debt (36,132) = 40,457. Interest Expense = gross interest on Debt (2,259) + Finance lease (424) = 2,683, before netting Interest income (546). Operating income and OCF both recovered strongly vs FY2023 (27,012 vs 20,428; 35,726 vs 28,841), confirming FY2023 dip was a one-off (debt extinguishment charge + divestiture-related losses), not a structural deterioration -- useful healthy-company contrast for validation section.
